\newcommand{\resultText}{ReLU attains the highest mean post-cost Sharpe (-0.530 $\pm$ 1.182); Q-ALU reaches -9.722 $\pm$ 6.889. Against GELU, Swish, ReLU the paired difference is negative, its interval excludes zero, and the signed-rank test rejects equality, so the arms are distinguishable and Q-ALU is the worse arm. The pre-registered direction was the opposite one; the hypothesis is rejected in reverse, and the sign we measured is the sign we report.}

\newcommand{\conclusionSentence}{Under a pre-registered purged walk-forward protocol with paired seeds and three independent tests, Q-ALU is significantly worse than every baseline it was set against, and the deficit is carried by turnover: the arm sits in a limit cycle on most cells and pays the fee on every flip.}
